tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Attorney General shall establish a National Gang Intelligence Center and gang information database to be housed at and administered by the Federal Bureau of Investigation to collect, analyze, and disseminate gang activity information from—

children.text: the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives;
the Directorate of Border and Transportation Security of the Department of Homeland Security;
the Department of Housing and Urban Development;
the Office of Justice Services of the Bureau of Indian Affairs;
tribal, State, and local law enforcement;
Federal, tribal, State, and local prosecutors;
Federal, tribal, State, and local probation and parole offices;
Federal, tribal, State, and local prisons and jails; and

tree.heading: Information
tree.text: The Center established under subsection (a) shall make available the information referred to in subsection (a) to—

children.text: Federal, tribal, State, and local law enforcement agencies;
Federal, tribal, State, and local corrections agencies and penal institutions;
Federal, tribal, State, and local prosecutorial agencies; and

tree.heading: Annual report
tree.text: The Center established under subsection (a) shall annually submit to Congress a report on gang activity.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $10,000,000 for fiscal year 2006 and for each fiscal year thereafter.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified as a note under section 534 of Title 28, Judiciary and Judicial Procedure, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
